$description: The Plenix themes: each theme is its foundations (typefaces, weights, letter spacing, shape, lines, motion, opacity, the focus ring; theme-<name>.tokens.json, the same in light and dark) and a full set of semantic color roles (surfaces, content, borders, actions, feedback…) in a light and a dark version, in platform/tokens/theme-<name>.light.tokens.json and .dark.tokens.json. This is the design system's definition: build-tokens.js generates one stylesheet per theme (platform/system/themes/<name>.css) and build-standards.js the list the apps offer (providers/themes.js, system/themes/index.css). A theme must define every role the default theme defines, and only point to palette colors (no new colors). Add a theme by adding its two token files and an entry here; pages switch with data-plx-theme on <html> (PlenixWorkspace.setTheme, useTheme).
